subtitle: warzone-5000: a realistic ground-vehicle simulator, built by thirteen domain agents working in parallel. This page is the coordinator's view.

strip.s: The Design Loop: tracked carrier, mud that decides who passes, the Impact Matrix running, a Workshop page. Slice 1 (three trucks, kid test drive) delivered and packaged
merged at 0982843: tyre load sensitivity, track definition and runs, articulation loads; S3, S4 and S6 all passed. FORGE's differential and brake-torque fields wait for the next bump
hash chain identical on both; every merge
ARCH plus 10 lanes; COMBAT, LOOK, VALIDATION idle; GODOT and AI parked

from list_sessions: GEOMETRY 45.5, CHASSIS 39.3, VIEWER 22.8, DRIVE 19.5, WORLD 16.4, FORGE 13.4, VALIDATION 7.0, TRACKS 6.6; the five-hour window is in its warning band (resets 20:30 UTC), so DRIVE, GEOMETRY, VIEWER idle and WORLD stops after one step

ranks.note: parallel-safe; launches when rank 1's first hour looks healthy
needs the settled Command and CapabilityTable

lanes.name: ARCH
lanes.mission: Contracts, CI and guardrails, the integration spine, merges, reviews. Writes no feature code.
lanes.last: w5k drive (live test-drive server, kid assists), course-compare, the proving-ground runner (braking, acceleration merged), the Windows package; lanes may now message ARCH

lanes.name: CHASSIS
lanes.mission: A wheeled vehicle that rides, grips and handles: hull, suspension, tyres, steering.
lanes.last: wheeled assembly, ledger, benches; sinking tyre (rigid-wheel Bekker) and tyre load sensitivity now read from the contract; the trucks stay linear until FORGE fills the fields

lanes.name: DRIVE
lanes.mission: Engine map, converter, gearbox, differentials, brakes with heat, fuel.
lanes.last: clutch launch and hill hold, authored brake torque, open/limited-slip/locked demonstration (Mule +13% grade from limited slip; Hauler is a launch-transient limit); steering-unit note for TRACKS; idle

lanes.name: WORLD
lanes.mission: The obstacle course: hills, roads, mud, trees, barricades, buildings.
lanes.last: rock fields, river, cliffs, bridges, mobility map (go/slow/no-go per vehicle) merged; mud pit and proving fixtures await a merge of integration; visual target V0 in progress

lanes.name: FORGE
lanes.mission: Designer choices to solver parameters; the reference garage starts with the HMMWV.
lanes.last: levers for differentials and brake torque merged; tracked-compile design note merged, T1 (stations, tracks, sprocket) in review

lanes.name: VIEWER
lanes.mission: Replay format, the browser viewer with forces drawn on, MP4 and chart tools.
lanes.last: tornado and ladder charts and the Workshop design note merged; idle until the tracked contact is real

lanes.name: VALIDATION
lanes.mission: Real-vehicle dossiers, the harness, the dashboard and the Design Impact Matrix.
lanes.last: Impact Matrix v0 run (31 of 54 signs), capability export for the mobility map merged; idle

lanes.name: GEOMETRY
lanes.mission: Realistic hulls, turrets, wheels and tracks from lofted sections.
lanes.last: the tracked carrier (belt module, skin from the compiled rig) merged; cavity-ray count to be exposed; idle

lanes.name: LOOK
lanes.mission: Camouflage, weathering, materials, lighting and dust.
lanes.last: three procedural camouflage schemes and weathering; idle

lanes.name: TRACKS
lanes.mission: Tracked running gear and soft ground: floats where tyres bog, turns by skidding.
lanes.last: S3 pivot torque within 4.6% of mu W L/4, S4 thrust within 0.4% of Wong; contact kernel, skid model, belly drag and ladder bench merged; wrapper and glue note next

lanes.name: GODOT
lanes.mission: The Godot 4.6 front end: replay player, drive mode, Windows package.
lanes.last: not launched; parked until after slice 2

lanes.name: COMBAT
lanes.mission: Ballistics, penetration, damage, targets, turret and gun servos, recoil.
lanes.last: spike S6 passed (momentum conserved to 1e-6); ballistics kernel; stopped to save budget

lanes.name: AI
lanes.mission: Perception, planner, driver, gunner, tactician; fair: it emits only what a human could.
lanes.last: not launched; parked until after slice 2

milestones.name: Launch Kit
milestones.criteria: Done: 13 briefs, guards proven by a bad PR, Linux and Windows hashes identical, contract 0.1.1 merged, launch rehearsal passed.

milestones.name: Settling round
milestones.criteria: Done: contract 0.2.0 from CHASSIS, DRIVE and FORGE requests; spikes S3, S4 and S6 have since run and passed, and contract 0.3.0 carries their findings.

milestones.name: First light
milestones.criteria: Demo: three wheeled vehicles drive a 520 m course, viewer, kid test drive. Gates met: quarter-car frequency and damping, energy drift, identical hashes on Linux and Windows. Gates open: Impact Matrix never run, figures against a real M998 unverified (sources unreachable), per-tick cost only roughly measured, Godot player not started.

milestones.name: Slice 2: The Design Loop
milestones.criteria: A tracked carrier, mud that decides who passes, the Impact Matrix running, a Workshop page where a design change moves measured numbers and can be driven. See docs/swarm/SLICE-2.md and card C-016.

milestones.name: Mud and steel
milestones.criteria: Tracked vehicles on soft ground; a 2 km course; held-out vehicles within 12% median error; Godot drive mode on Windows.

milestones.name: Turret and targets
milestones.criteria: Recoil conserves momentum; traverse and elevation times within 20%; damage changes mobility.

milestones.name: Thinking vehicles
milestones.criteria: At least 90% course completion for five vehicles, stuck under 3%, rollover under 1%.

log.note: Launch Kit under way. This session's meter reads about $204 after about 20 hours.
Owner warned of about $20 of credit left: ARCH stopped and left the repository green. Handoff: docs/architecture/CONTRACT-0.1.1-PLAN.md and docs/swarm/STATE.md.
Contract 0.1.1 merged into integration (PR 2) and green on Linux and Windows. Next: the launch rehearsal; no lane launched.

Launch rehearsal passed. One small CHASSIS session cloned, branched, wrote its status file, ran the math tests, pushed and opened PR 3; the lane guard and CI passed and ARCH merged it ($0.23 for the whole session). It tried to force-push and was refused, as designed. Fixes made: the launch prompt now says how to sign commits and never to amend; the contract pin is a commit id. Rank 1 is not launched; it waits for your go.

Your four answers are applied (C-001 era, C-002 garage, C-003 courses, C-007 models); the page shows each with my reading of it, so please check I read you right. Docs only, about $1 to $1.5 of your remaining $8. Nothing launched.

You went to sleep and said run without checking in. Eight lanes launched; 27 lane PRs merged; contract v0.2 applied; integration went red on Windows only (CRLF line endings in baked JSON) and a repo-wide LF fix is in PR 36. Lanes cost about $0.5 to $1.5 each so far.
Slice 1 delivered: the truck drives the course with forces drawn, clip and Control Room sent. Lanes about $51 at this point.

You ran the Windows package and liked it. START.bat now has no speed limiter; START-KID.bat keeps the 25 km/h cap. Slice 2 proposed (The Design Loop); three new cards: C-016 (slice 2), C-017 (where real published figures come from), C-018 (oracle tolerance class). Nothing new launches without your go.

You said go: slice 2 is on. TRACKS and COMBAT launched; the other lanes have their stage A jobs (tyre load sensitivity, terrain spectrum fix, lever API, Impact Matrix runner, charts, tracked carrier). Slice 1 package unchanged: run 38069793130.

Contract 0.3.0 merged; seven lane PRs landed this hour (DRIVE launch and hill hold, FORGE levers, TRACKS contact, skid and ladder, GEOMETRY carrier, VIEWER charts, CHASSIS sinking tyre, WORLD mobility map). Spikes S3 and S4 passed, so the tracked path is safe to build. Usage window in its warning band: lanes about $177, non-critical lanes idled until 20:30 UTC.
